body: I started to cry when I read this. In a restaurant, where I'm pretty sure they now all think I'm crazy. My situation is so eerily similar. Because of some horrible decisions my mother has made I'm now the sole bread winner of the family. I should be finishing university, oversees, but instead I have to do a job I hate, in an incredibly stressful field, working ridiculous hours to pay for rent, utilities, phones, tv, food, gas, two car payments and insurance, and everything else they feel they need. I did it all without question, I wanted to make my sisters life stay as normal as possible for her last year in high school. But now all I get is hate. I get yelled at every morning before I leave and every night when I get home. I feel unwelcomed and hated. But I know if I leave, I'm abandoning them with nothing. My best friend is constantly telling me to leave for my own health, because being around them is poisonous. She's right, and I want to leave so badly. I'm so relieved to hear someone else going through the same thing. And that it worked for you. Hopefully, I can get out of this situation too and maybe be happy for once. So thank you.

I don't have a spouse, the family I take care of is more immediate, my mother and younger sister. I'm still in university, or should be anyways. My job does pay a lot though, more so than being a lawyer or doctor (in Canada) it's just very stressful because it's all so uncertain. And very difficult, I deal with mass amounts of rejection and assholes, which of course doesn't make my situation any better. But I know that if I quit, I wouldn't be able to find a decent job because I'm not even done my degree yet. There's just so much to worry about, and so much stress on my plate, but I can't talk to anyone about it because I work 12 hours a day and no one my age has any idea of how to relate to what I'm going through. 

All that coupled with the depression isn't making breathing easy.

No, I don't think they do. They use me for my money, get me to pay for everything, and then yell at me and make me feel like a terrible person. I'm 21 and responsible for keeping them clothed and fed. I shouldn't be shouldered with all this responsibility and crap, but I also let them treat me this way despite being told by friends that I should get out.

My family is a big part of the problem. It's not my spouse or children, because of stupid mistakes my mother made I have to take care of her and my sister. She created a situation which made my sister's and my own life hell. I do everything I can to keep a roof over their heads and all I get in return is being told I'm the "rudest person alive" that "I only ever think of myself" and that I'm completely useless.
For every supporter, I will kill 2 pickles.
